Multi-Agent AI Oracle System - Implementation Details (Methodology Input)

- Outputs/results: /Users/tarunkota/Desktop/Senior-Thesis-Multi-LLM-Resolution/results

2) System Architecture Implemented
Pipeline:
KalshiBench question -> Exa retrieval (shared evidence packet) -> 3 LLM agents -> aggregation -> metrics/output

- Architecture A (independent multi-agent voting)
  - Runner: src/resolution/runner.py (MultiAgentRunner)
  - Default agents in current code: GPT-5 nano + DeepSeek-V3 + Llama-3.3-70B
  - Optional swaps: Claude for DeepSeek, Gemini for Llama
  - Aggregation: majority vote; ties default to NO

- Architecture B (2-round debate + cross-examination)
  - Runner: src/resolution/debate/runner.py (MultiLLMDebateRunner)
  - Round 1: independent decisions from identical evidence
  - Round 2: each agent sees anonymized peer reasoning and may revise
  - Final aggregation:
    1) round-2 majority
    2) if tie, round-1 majority
    3) if still tie, default NO

3) Final Evaluation Dataset Used (Important)
This is the final dataset description to report (not the earlier pilot subset-only runs).

Final evaluated set size:
- 1189 rows/markets

Temporal filtering rationale and boundary:
- Markets are filtered to close on/after 2025-05-01 to reduce training-period leakage risk for frontier LLMs.
- Post-filter evaluation set size: 1189 rows.
- Verified from final evaluation file close_time:
  - minimum close_time: 2025-05-01 15:27:26.712799+00:00
  - maximum close_time: 2025-11-16 22:44:43.836516+00:00
  - rows before 2025-05-01: 0

Class balance in the final 1189-row dataset (ground_truth):
- YES: 488 (41.04%)
- NO: 701 (58.96%)

Category distribution in the final 1189-row dataset:
- Politics: 311 (26.16%)
- Sports: 269 (22.62%)

4) Data Loading and Representation
Loader module: src/data/kalshi_loader.py
- Dataset source ID: 2084Collective/kalshibench-v2
- Local-first loading behavior:
  - prefers cache/kalshibench-v2 when present
  - otherwise loads from Hugging Face datasets API
- Optional env override: KALSHI_BENCH_DATA_DIR

Question fields used in experiments:
- id
- question
- description (resolution criteria)
- category
- close_time (resolution date reference)
- ground_truth (yes/no, normalized to YES/NO for scoring)

5) Evidence Retrieval Layer (Shared Across Agents)
Retriever: src/retrieval/exa_retriever.py (ExaOracleRetriever)

Core design control:
- Every agent receives the same EvidencePacket for a question.
- This isolates reasoning differences from retrieval differences.

Query construction:
- Template: What is the result of this question "<question_text_without_trailing_?>"

Retrieval settings (script defaults):
- retrieval_mode: highlights (default) or full_text
- num_results: 10
- full_text max chars/source: 4000
- highlights max chars: 2000 (or Exa default if CLI sets 0)

Temporal retrieval filter:
- end_published_date = resolution_date + 1 day

Caching behavior:
- JSON cache directory default: cache/evidence
- Cache key in run scripts: <retrieval_mode>__<row_uid>

EvidencePacket schema (src/retrieval/evidence.py):
- question_id, question_text, resolution_criteria, resolution_date
- retrieval_timestamp, query_used
- sources[] where source has title, url, published_date, text, highlights[]

6) LLM Agent Implementations and Structured Output
Shared base class: src/agents/base.py
- Standardized output per agent:
  - decision (YES/NO or null on failure)
  - confidence [0,1]
  - reasoning
  - latency_ms
  - prompt_tokens/completion_tokens (if API provides)
  - error field on failure
- Robust error path returns structured failed records (does not crash run)

Shared prompting:
- src/agents/prompts.py system + user template
- Agents consume EvidencePacket.format_for_prompt() output

Agent implementations:
- OpenAI (src/agents/openai_agent.py)
  - AGENT_NAME/MODEL: gpt-5-nano
  - SDK: openai chat.completions
  - Structured output: json_schema
  - Retry: 3 attempts (1s, 2s, 4s)
  - Env key: OPENAI_API_KEY

- DeepSeek via Together (src/agents/deepseek_agent.py)
  - MODEL: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3
  - Structured output: tries json_schema, falls back to json_object when rejected
  - Retry: 3 attempts (1s, 2s, 4s)
  - Env keys: TOGETHER_API_KEY, optional TOGETHER_BASE_URL

- Llama via Together (src/agents/llama_agent.py)
  - MODEL: meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo
  - Structured output: same schema->json_object fallback
  - Retry: 3 attempts (1s, 2s, 4s)
  - Env keys: TOGETHER_API_KEY, optional TOGETHER_BASE_URL

- Gemini(optional) (src/agents/google_agent.py)
  - MODEL: gemini-2.0-flash
  - SDK: google-genai
  - Structured output: response_mime_type=application/json + Pydantic schema
  - Retry: 3 attempts (1s, 2s, 4s)
  - Env key: GOOGLE_API_KEY

- Claude (optional) (src/agents/anthropic_agent.py)
  - MODEL: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
  - Structured output: forced tool-use schema
  - Retry: 3 attempts (1s, 2s, 4s)
  - Env key: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

7) Aggregation and Tie-Break Rules
Architecture A (src/resolution/aggregation.py):
- yes_votes = count(successful YES)
- no_votes = count(successful NO)
- final_decision = YES if yes_votes > no_votes else NO

Architecture B (src/resolution/debate/runner.py):
- compute vote totals for round 1 and round 2
- final decision order:
  - round 2 majority
  - else round 1 majority
  - else default NO
- tie_break_method persisted in outputs

9) Output Artifacts and Metrics
Per-row outputs include:
- question metadata
- per-agent decision/confidence/reasoning/error
- aggregated decision + vote counts
- correctness flag
- latency/timing fields

Summary outputs include:
- processed/skipped/failed counts
- overall accuracy
- per-agent accuracy
- agreement/revision/convergence metrics (architecture-dependent)
- runtime and estimated retrieval cost

11) Reproducibility/Validity Points to Mention in Methodology
- Shared-evidence control across agents (same Exa packet per question)
- Structured output constraints per provider (schema/tool-enforced)
- Retry/error handling with non-crashing failed-record outputs
- Deterministic tie behavior (explicit default paths)
- Explicit post-cutoff market selection (>=2025-05-01)
- Final evaluated dataset statistics reported with class and category balance
